annotations.title: Upload a picture to search with

description: Get a link to send a picture to (a screenshot, a mockup, a photo of a sketch), to search sections with it: for agents that can run a shell command. Send the file with the curl command in the answer; it answers with the picture's id, which goes in search_sections' image, with q saying what you want from it ("replacements for this hero", "the opposite", "like this but dark"; empty: lookalikes). The link works for 15 minutes, for as many pictures as you need. PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 4 MB: shrink a larger screenshot first (sips -Z 1600 on a Mac, magick -resize 1600x elsewhere). Only this account's searches can use the picture; it is kept 30 days.
name: upload_image

curl.description: The command that sends a file there; put the file's path after @.

upload_url.description: Where to send the picture: POST its bytes. Works until expires_at, for any number of pictures.
